svg.title: Blueprint sheet 12, the lantern: you can only see the ground near you, so take the best next step from here, then look again

g.text: take the best step from here, then look again
past the light, nobody can see.
lots of ground all round it,
on top, every way is down.
and there is no way back.
works when you can see the map.
a good tool. here the map is fog.
start with a way to head,
not a place to get to.
a living blueprint for a world
